searchText: In cases 2–5, the tests are set up in a way where the base fee error fires first, which isn't what the test author intended. For example, ethSimulate-gas-fees-and-value-error-38014-with-validation triggers the base fee error before the actual check being tested —> verified this in Geth, Nethermind, and Erigon. The code mismatch shown in the table is due to the base fee error: spec expects -38012 but the fixture has -32602. Yep for those we should extend the test suite to accept multiple valid error codes. The order of operations should not be imposed on clients what's the situation on this? did this land in a spec somewhere? wanted to merge this PR, but didn't see any concrete definition of the schema / handling https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/35029

excerpts.author: sambhavjain6766
excerpts.content:
In cases 2–5, the tests are set up in a way where the base fee error fires first, which isn't what the test author intended. For example, ethSimulate-gas-fees-and-value-error-38014-with-validation triggers the base fee error before the actual check being tested —> verified this in Geth, Nethermind, and Erigon.

The code mismatch shown in the table is due to the base fee error: spec expects -38012 but the fixture has -32602.

excerpts.author: s1na
excerpts.content: Yep for those we should extend the test suite to accept multiple valid error codes. The order of operations should not be imposed on clients
